title: Singular value spectrum of embeddings submatrices

cues.en: In this and the next video, I will discuss using the singular value decomposition, often abbreviated
cues.zh: 這部與下一部影片，會討論使用奇異值分解，通常縮寫為

cues.en: to SVD, to identify an optimal basis vector that is aligned with a particular category, which we will
cues.zh: SVD，找出與特定類別對齊的最佳基底向量；這裡將類別

cues.en: define as groups of related tokens, for example digits or letters or countries.
cues.zh: 定義成一組相關 token，例如數字、字母或國家。

cues.en: I will provide a big picture overview of the SVD in the next few slides, but I will be honest with
cues.zh: 接下來幾張投影片，會概述 SVD，但老實說，

cues.en: you, if you have not taken linear algebra and this is your first ever exposure to the SVD, then it might seem a little overwhelming.
cues.zh: 如果沒修過線性代數，而且第一次接觸 SVD，可能會覺得有點負擔。

cues.en: So I'm not going to get into the math details of the SVD, but I will explain how to interpret the key results that we will use here.
cues.zh: 所以，不會深入 SVD 的數學細節，但會解釋如何解讀這裡要用的關鍵結果。

cues.en: Then I'll switch to Python and show a demo.
cues.zh: 接著切換到 Python 示範。

cues.en: And in the next video I will guide you through continuing to explore using the SVD in embeddings matrices.
cues.zh: 下一部影片，會引導你繼續探索，在嵌入矩陣中使用 SVD。

cues.en: So the big picture idea of the SVD is to decompose one matrix, which I'm showing here on the left and labeling it a matrix A.
cues.zh: SVD 的整體概念，是分解一個矩陣，這裡畫在左邊，標記為 A。

cues.en: So decompose this matrix as the product of three other matrices and they are called u sigma and v transpose.
cues.zh: 把它分解成另外三個矩陣的乘積，分別叫 U、Σ 與 V 的轉置。

cues.en: Now u and V provide orthogonal optimized basis vectors for the column and row spaces of the matrix.
cues.zh: U 與 V 為矩陣的欄空間與列空間，提供正交、經最佳化的基底向量。

cues.en: So each column of U and each row in V transpose is called a singular vector.
cues.zh: U 的每一欄，以及 V 轉置的每一列，都稱為奇異向量。

cues.en: In the next few slides, I will show a geometric and statistical interpretation of what those vectors do and why they are important.
cues.zh: 接下來幾張投影片，會從幾何與統計解釋這些向量的作用，以及為什麼重要。

cues.en: And this matrix here sigma is a diagonal matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡的 Σ 是對角矩陣。

cues.en: So it's all zeros on the off diagonals.
cues.zh: 所以，對角線之外全部是零。

cues.en: And the diagonal elements contain what are called the singular values, which encode the importance of each of the vectors in u and v transpose.
cues.zh: 對角線元素是所謂的奇異值，編碼 U 與 V 轉置中，各向量的重要性。

cues.en: So what does all this mean in the context of an embeddings matrix?
cues.zh: 這對嵌入矩陣代表什麼？

cues.en: What you see now in this slide is an adaptation of the previous slide to an embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 現在這張投影片，是將上一張內容改成嵌入矩陣的情況。

cues.en: So now imagine we have embeddings matrix which here I'm calling E that has one row for each token.
cues.zh: 想像有嵌入矩陣，這裡稱為 E，每一列對應一個 token。

cues.en: And the columns correspond to embeddings dimensions.
cues.zh: 欄則對應嵌入維度。

cues.en: Now normally this is actually a tall matrix because there are many tens of thousands or maybe hundreds
cues.zh: 通常它其實是高矩陣，因為有數萬，甚至數十萬

cues.en: of thousands of tokens and just some hundreds or maybe a thousand embedding dimensions.
cues.zh: 個 token，而嵌入維度只有數百，或大約一千。

cues.en: But when we take the SVD here in this and the next video, we are actually only considering a submatrix
cues.zh: 但這部與下一部影片取 SVD 時，其實只考慮

cues.en: of the full embeddings matrix that is formed by selecting a relatively small number of tokens, maybe 20 or 30 tokens.
cues.zh: 完整嵌入矩陣的一個子矩陣，選相對少數 token，例如 20 或 30 個。

cues.en: So that's submatrix actually is a wide matrix like this.
cues.zh: 因此，子矩陣其實是這樣的寬矩陣。

cues.en: Now with this orientation, the U matrix provides information about the tokens dimension which we don't actually care about for this application.
cues.zh: 在這個方向下，U 矩陣提供 token 維度的資訊，但這個應用不在乎它。

cues.en: So I'm going to completely ignore this matrix for the next two videos.
cues.zh: 所以，接下來兩部影片完全忽略這個矩陣。

cues.en: So then we have the singular values and v transpose.
cues.zh: 剩下奇異值，以及 V 的轉置。

cues.en: And here I'm illustrating that the singular values are on the diagonal of the of the sigma matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡展示，奇異值位於 Σ 矩陣的對角線。

cues.en: And these are sorted.
cues.zh: 而且已排序。

cues.en: So the largest singular value is top left and then they get smaller as you go down to the right.
cues.zh: 最大的奇異值在左上，往右下越來越小。

cues.en: And then we have the row vectors in V transpose.
cues.zh: 接著，V 轉置中有各個列向量。

cues.en: Those are paired with the singular values.
cues.zh: 它們與奇異值配對。

cues.en: And these are the optimal basis vectors for the embedding space of matrix E.
cues.zh: 是矩陣 E 的嵌入空間中，最佳的基底向量。

cues.en: Now there are actually many rows in this V transpose matrix.
cues.zh: V 轉置矩陣其實有很多列。

cues.en: But for this and the next video we are only concerned with the first vector, which is the one associated with the largest singular value.
cues.zh: 但這部與下一部影片，只關心第一個向量，也就是與最大奇異值相關聯的向量。

cues.en: Now there are situations where you would be interested in the later vectors as well.
cues.zh: 有些情況，也會對後面的向量感興趣。

cues.en: We are not going to worry about that here.
cues.zh: 這裡不考慮。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let's focus on these two matrices.
cues.zh: 專注在這兩個矩陣。

cues.en: What do they mean and how do we interpret them?
cues.zh: 它們代表什麼，如何解讀？

cues.en: Let's start with the singular values.
cues.zh: 先看奇異值。

cues.en: If you extract the diagonal elements and plot them, you would get a plot that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 擷取對角線元素並畫圖，就會得到類似這樣的圖。

cues.en: This is called a singular value spectrum, or sometimes it's called a scree plot.
cues.zh: 稱為奇異值譜，有時也叫陡坡圖。

cues.en: Fun fact it's called a scree plot because it's named after scree, which is the term for when you're climbing a mountain.
cues.zh: 有個小知識：scree plot 的名稱來自 scree，也就是登山時，

cues.en: And there's a lot of small rocks at the bottom of the cliff face that you're trying to climb.
cues.zh: 想攀爬的峭壁底部，有許多小石頭。

cues.en: Those rocks are called the scree.
cues.zh: 那些石頭就叫 scree，碎石堆。

cues.en: So here you imagine the cliff face.
cues.zh: 這裡可以想像是峭壁。

cues.en: And here's all the little rocks down here.
cues.zh: 下面則是所有小石頭。

cues.en: Anyway, that term scree is more common in the statistics literature.
cues.zh: 總之，scree 這個詞在統計文獻更常見。

cues.en: I'm not going to use it here in this course, other than just to introduce you to the terminology.
cues.zh: 課程中不會使用，只是介紹術語讓你知道。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what I want you to see when you look at a singular value spectrum in this example, is that there's
cues.zh: 看這個例子的奇異值譜時，希望你注意，

cues.en: one component, one singular value that really pops out from the rest of the distribution.
cues.zh: 有一個成分、一個奇異值，明顯高於其餘分布。

cues.en: This would be a beautiful result here.
cues.zh: 這會是很漂亮的結果。

cues.en: So you see one large singular value, and the rest are relatively small and close to each other.
cues.zh: 可以看到一個很大的奇異值，其餘相對小、彼此接近。

cues.en: So this indicates that there is one meaningful direction in the embeddings vector space that can be
cues.zh: 這表示，嵌入向量空間中有一個有意義的方向，可以

cues.en: used to characterize all of the vectors that you put into the embeddings submatrix.
cues.zh: 用來描述放進嵌入子矩陣的所有向量。

cues.en: Alternatively, if your singular value spectrum looks something like this, where there doesn't seem
cues.zh: 另一方面，如果奇異值譜像這樣，似乎沒有

cues.en: to be really strong separation of the first component from the rest, then this suggests that there
cues.zh: 讓第一個成分與其餘成分明確分開，這暗示

cues.en: are no really strong meaningful directions in the embeddings submatrix.
cues.zh: 嵌入子矩陣中，沒有非常強、有意義的方向。

cues.en: In fact, if you have an embeddings matrix that is pure noise, just pure random numbers, its singular value spectrum will look like this.
cues.zh: 事實上，如果嵌入矩陣全是雜訊、純隨機數，奇異值譜就會像這樣。

cues.en: So this is basically just sorted noise values.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是排序過的雜訊值。

cues.en: Now to be clear, this kind of result doesn't mean that your data are pure noise, or that there's nothing interesting in your data.
cues.zh: 先說清楚，這種結果不表示資料是純雜訊，也不表示資料沒有有趣的東西。

cues.en: It just means that there is no lower dimensional linear structure that can be linearly separated into a single dimension or a single basis vector.
cues.zh: 只是表示，沒有能以線性方式分離成單一維度或單一基底向量的低維線性結構。

cues.en: Instead, it suggests that your data would look more like an isotropic cloud in the data space.
cues.zh: 反而暗示，資料在資料空間中，看起來較像各向同性的雲團。

cues.en: Okay, let me try to make that a little bit more concrete.
cues.zh: 再試著說得具體一點。

cues.en: So imagine we have a result that looks like this.
cues.zh: 假設結果像這樣。

cues.en: So something with really nice separation between the first component and the rest of the components
cues.zh: 第一個成分與其餘成分分得很好，

cues.en: that would come from the SVD of data that might look something like this.
cues.zh: 可能來自對這樣的資料做 SVD。

cues.en: So here I am plotting the embeddings vectors for two tokens.
cues.zh: 這裡畫出兩個 token 的嵌入向量。

cues.en: You can see that there's obviously some very strong correlation between them.
cues.zh: 顯然，它們之間有很強的相關。

cues.en: So the first embeddings basis vector the first row of V transpose would give us something like this.
cues.zh: 第一個嵌入基底向量，也就是 V 轉置第一列，會像這樣。

cues.en: It's a big vector.
cues.zh: 是一個大向量。

cues.en: It identifies that the most important direction in this data space is the direction that has the most
cues.zh: 它辨識出，資料空間最重要的方向，是這兩個嵌入之間

cues.en: amount of variance between or across the two embeddings.
cues.zh: 或跨兩個嵌入，變異數最多的方向。

cues.en: So largest direction of covariation.
cues.zh: 也就是共同變動最大的方向。

cues.en: So the next row in V transpose might look something like this.
cues.zh: V 轉置下一列，可能像這樣。

cues.en: Now that vector is still capturing some direction of covariation in the data.
cues.zh: 它仍然捕捉資料中某個共同變動的方向。

cues.en: But it's smaller.
cues.zh: 但比較小。

cues.en: It's less meaningful.
cues.zh: 比較沒有意義。

cues.en: So this thick orange line would be associated with that really large singular value.
cues.zh: 所以，這條粗橘線對應那個非常大的奇異值。

cues.en: And this line would be associated with a smaller singular value.
cues.zh: 這條線則對應比較小的奇異值。

cues.en: Now here we can visualize this result because it's only in two dimensions.
cues.zh: 這裡只有二維，所以能視覺化結果。

cues.en: And I'm just using two embeddings vectors.
cues.zh: 而且只用兩個嵌入向量。

cues.en: In practice we are going to be using 10 to 30 vectors.
cues.zh: 實際上，會使用 10 到 30 個向量。

cues.en: So we cannot make these kinds of scatter plots, which means we cannot just plot the data and look at these vectors.
cues.zh: 所以，無法做這種散佈圖，不能直接畫資料、查看這些向量。

cues.en: But for two dimensions, this is how it would work.
cues.zh: 但二維時，就是這樣運作。

cues.en: This is the picture you should have in mind.
cues.zh: 心中應該想像這幅畫面。

cues.en: Now, once we have this vector, what we can do is project all of the individual data points onto this
cues.zh: 一旦有了這個向量，就能把每個資料點投影到這個

cues.en: vector, and that tells us how much each individual data point falls onto this vector.
cues.zh: 向量，知道各資料點在向量上有多少成分。

cues.en: So what we're actually going to do is not project the individual data points but individual tokens.
cues.zh: 實際要做的，不是投影個別資料點，而是個別 token。

cues.en: So we will be able to calculate how much each token, or more precisely, the embeddings vector for
cues.zh: 所以，可以計算每個 token，更精確地說，每個 token 的嵌入向量，

cues.en: each token maps onto or projects onto this vector that is defined by the embeddings for a couple of
cues.zh: 有多少映射或投影到這個向量；而這個向量是由幾個

cues.en: tokens, whatever is in our sub Uh, matrix.
cues.zh: token 的嵌入所定義，也就是子矩陣中的那些 token。

cues.en: Okay, one more point to bring up before moving on.
cues.zh: 繼續之前，再提一點。

cues.en: These singular vectors have positive and negative values, but the sign of the vector is kind of arbitrary and it's not really interpretable.
cues.zh: 奇異向量有正值與負值，但向量的正負號有點任意，不太能解讀。

cues.en: In part that's because the data are mean centered, and in part that's just inherent to the SVD.
cues.zh: 部分是因為資料做了平均中心化，部分則是 SVD 本身的特性。

cues.en: There is this sign indeterminacy of the singular vectors.
cues.zh: 奇異向量有這種正負號不定性。

cues.en: So that means that we will look at these projections both for positive and for negative signed projections.
cues.zh: 所以，會同時查看正向與負向投影。

cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this was the situation for a really nice separation in the singular value spectrum.
cues.zh: 這是奇異值譜分離得很好的情況。

cues.zh: 但如果奇異值譜沒有良好分離，奇異向量本身

cues.en: It's really a beautiful matrix decomposition, and it's actually intuitive and straightforward, but
cues.zh: 這真的是漂亮的矩陣分解，其實也直覺、直接，

cues.zh: 對這些子矩陣做平均中心化，對 SVD 很重要，確保真正辨識的是

cues.en: And so if you are trying to classify text as being, let's say, positive sentiment or negative sentiment, you know, is this Amazon review positive or negative?
cues.zh: 如果想把文字分成正向情緒或負向情緒，例如 Amazon 評論是正面還是負面？

cues.en: Does this email look like it's spam or a legit email?
cues.zh: 這封電子郵件看起來是垃圾郵件，還是正常郵件？

cues.en: Single letters that are separated from other, you know, single letters as words are just not very informative.
cues.zh: 獨立於其他字母、作為單字出現的單一字母，並沒有太多資訊。

cues.en: They're not very diagnostic for this kind of application.
cues.zh: 對這類應用，沒有太多判別力。

cues.en: So I suspect that Bert just doesn't really care about single letters, certainly not when they are coming in at the level of the initial embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 因此，我懷疑 BERT 不太在意單一字母，尤其在初始嵌入矩陣這個層級。

cues.en: I hope you found this video interesting and thought provoking.
cues.zh: 希望這部影片有意思，也能引發思考。

cues.en: There are four points here on this slide, but I mainly want to talk about the last one.
cues.zh: 投影片有四點，但主要想談最後一點。

cues.en: One way to interpret what the SVD is doing is that it's kind of like averaging all the embeddings vectors
cues.zh: 解讀 SVD 的一種方式，是有點像將子矩陣中所有嵌入向量取平均，

cues.en: in the submatrix, but averaging them in a smart way, such that the weight for each individual vector
cues.zh: 但以聰明的方式取平均，讓各向量的權重，

cues.en: is calculated based on how much that vector looks like the collection of other vectors.
cues.zh: 根據它與其他向量集合的相似程度來計算。

cues.en: So that is one way to see what we've done here.
cues.zh: 這是看待這裡做法的一種方式。

cues.en: We've taken an average of the embeddings for all the letters, but the way that we average them together
cues.zh: 我們把所有字母的嵌入取平均，但平均的方式，

cues.en: is adapted to the statistical characteristics of the data, as opposed to just weighting each individual embedding vector by one over n.
cues.zh: 是根據資料的統計特性調整，而不是簡單地給每個嵌入向量 1/n 的權重。
